FIKTIVA CITY CODE (FICTIONAL)

CHAPTER I

Article 1 Public notice

INVENTED TEXT. The City of Fiktiva & its board publish every public notice for fourteen days.

Article 2 Gatherings

INVENTED TEXT. A gathering of fewer than fifty people needs no permit.

CHAPTER II

Article 3 Fountains

INVENTED TEXT. Fountains stay open — from spring to autumn.

Article 4 Wells

INVENTED TEXT. A well may not be closed without a notice.

Article 5 Appeals

INVENTED TEXT. A resident may appeal within thirty days.
